question.nlq: Retrieve the contact information for all customers who placed successful actual orders during the year 2018.

meanings.hidden_knowledge: When I say 'contact information', I am referring to the customer's email address. This is the electronic communication method associated with each customer profile, not their telephone number.
meanings.gt_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_email
FROM Customers c
JOIN Regular_Orders ro ON c.customer_id = ro.distributer_id
JOIN Actual_Orders ao ON ro.regular_order_id = ao.regular_order_id
WHERE ao.order_status_code = 'Success'
AND strftime('%Y', ao.actual_order_date) = '2018'
